name: agent_recv
description: Receive pending mailbox messages for this session, waiting (parked at this session's runner) up to the bounded timeout when none are pending. A child parked here yields its execution slot. Delivery is at-least-once: unconsumed deliveries are re-delivered after a crash, deduped on message_id. On timeout the call fails and you are expected to drop the coordination: write your report/deferral state and finish.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a message (default 60, max 600). On timeout the call fails: drop the coordination, write your report/deferral state, and finish

items.description: Inbound relayed message from a sibling (or the coordinator itself, from_agent_id == ""). Reply via PeerSendRequest.in_reply_to. Until delivered, a queued PeerMessage is durable, role-addressed mailbox state at the coordinator: it survives coordinator process restarts and is delivered when the target reattaches.

kind.description: The message's kind, from a CLOSED vocabulary — guaranteed to be one of these names, because an unrecognised value is refused at ingress rather than delivered unclassified. A SENDER could only have set one of MESSAGE_KIND_MESSAGE, MESSAGE_KIND_RESULT, MESSAGE_KIND_ERROR, MESSAGE_KIND_QUESTION; the rest are minted by the coordinator itself and are therefore trustworthy as to provenance. MESSAGE_KIND_APPROVAL_REQUEST is an escalation WAITING on your decision (see `structured`); MESSAGE_KIND_USER_INJECTED means a human injected text into a session you supervise; MESSAGE_KIND_EXITED means a child of yours ended; MESSAGE_KIND_USER_CONTROL and MESSAGE_KIND_STEER are control-plane notices.

structured.description: Structured companion the sender attached, when there is one. A message whose `kind` is MESSAGE_KIND_APPROVAL_REQUEST carries the escalation ladder's ApprovalRequest projection here and is WAITING on you: answer it with agent_send(in_reply_to: this message_id, structured: {"decision": "DECISION_ACCEPT" | "DECISION_ACCEPT_FOR_SESSION" | "DECISION_DECLINE" | "DECISION_CANCEL", "note": "..."}). Until that lands the requesting child is blocked, and it is auto-DECLINED if the rung's timeout elapses first. This object no longer carries the message kind — read the `kind` field.
